items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use Company Tea generator at C.A.M.P. if available

items.title: Collect Brain Fungus
items.detail: Found in dark caves like Wendigo Cave, Kerwood Mine, or Abandoned Waste Dump

items.title: Complete the Event: "The Big Bloom"
items.detail: Event runs hourly at Susan's Cabin in Skyline Valley

items.title: Harvest a Firecracker Berry
items.detail: Found north and northwest of Arktos Pharma; harvest quickly before they explode

items.title: Kill an Insect during The Big Bloom Event
items.detail: Kill insects during event waves at Susan's Cabin

items.title: Kill an Overgrown during The Big Bloom Event while wearing a Flower Crown
items.detail: Equip flower crown and kill Overgrown during event waves

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from killed enemies

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use Games Cupboard at C.A.M.P. to collect board games

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Any robot type counts; RobCo Research Center is ideal

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations or plant at C.A.M.P. for on-demand gathering

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest during final stage of Slasher seasonal event at Head Hunt

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Whitespring Resort vendors or find at Pumpkin House

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any NPC vendor; cheap grenades work

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Find player camps with shelters marked by radiation symbol on map

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points and XP buffs for faster progression.

events.description: Major update introducing world pets and starting Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event combined with double mutations for increased farming rewards.
